invariants_error_checks: isCurrent verifies sequence, same attempt, foreground, not hard-stopped, generation and scope. Background and clear invalidate prior completions; reconcileCurrentQueue uses task status/version projection. Mutation state is not direct proof of server assignment.

semantic_review_notes: Read 59/59. executeEmployeeTaskAction performs assign (when claim-and-accept) using expectedVersion then verifies assigned taskId/status/assignee/version before sequential accept; returns reconcile for ambiguous/committed errors and stale if action-owner fence fails.

semantic_review_notes: Read 209/209. Closed source-specific classification sets and operation whitelist.
